text.description_html:
CRL9162 Medium Duty 90º 3/4" Long Spindle Overhead Concealed Closer Body with Mounting Clips

This CRL Overhead Concealed Closer for Patch Fittings and Door Rails have a longer spindle approximately 3/4" (19 mm). The closer has dual action valves for closing operation (one valve for closing, one valve for latching). The CRL9162 is a 90º No Hold Open door closer. Interchangeable with International, Jackson® and similar brands of Overhead Concealed Closers. Mounting Clips and instructions are included with each Door Closer Body.

Features and Specifications: of the CRL Overhead Concealed Closer :

  • Spindle Length: 3/4"
  • Handing: Double Acting
  • Body Width: 3-11/16"
  • Body Length: 11-5/8"
  • Body Height 1-11/16"
  • No Hold Open 90°
  • UL Listed
  • Maximum Door Weight: 200 Lbs. (91 kg)
  • Maximum Exterior Door Width: 42" (1.07 m)
  • Maximum Interior Door Width: 48" (1.22 m)
  • Maximum Door Height: 96" (2.44 m)

Special Ordered Item. Final Sale
